verification.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c 'import json,re,subprocess; base="00e0bcb1bd16ba2ddaf5774153bbf2c1e05244a6"; run=lambda a: subprocess.check_output(["git",*a]).decode("utf-8").split("\0"); projections={"committed":run(["diff","--no-renames","--name-only","-z",base,"HEAD","--"]),"index":run(["diff","--cached","--no-renames","--name-only","-z",base,"--"]),"worktree":run(["diff","--no-renames","--name-only","-z",base,"--"]),"untracked":run(["ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard","-z"])}; paths=set(p for ps in projections.values() for p in ps if p); exact={"tools/start_path.py","tools/test_start_path.py",".agent/contracts/NIZAM-R02-COMPLETION.json",".agent/qa/NIZAM-R02-COMPLETION.json",".agent/qa/NIZAM-R02-COMPLETION-contract-review.json"}; patterns=['"'"'\\.agent/qa/NIZAM-R02-COMPLETION(?:-contract-review)?-(?:[0-9]{2,}|rev[1-9][0-9]*)\\.json'"'"', '"'"'\\.agent/evidence/NIZAM-R02-COMPLETION-[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}-attempt[1-9][0-9]*\\.reservation\\.json'"'"']; unexpected=sorted(p for p in paths if p not in exact and not p.startswith(".agent/evidence/NIZAM-R02-COMPLETION/") and not any(re.fullmatch(q,p) for q in patterns)); print(json.dumps({"base":base,"projections":{k:sorted(p for p in v if p) for k,v in projections.items()},"changed_paths":sorted(paths),"unexpected":unexpected},sort_keys=True)); assert not unexpected, unexpected'

capture_plan.attempt: assigned by Root; never reset by process/workspace handoff
capture_plan.candidate: full canonical candidate identity/digest assigned at activation
capture_plan.proof_policy: Each required wrapper must actually execute and exit zero. A timeout, setup failure, skip, missing function, swallowed error or missing expected diagnostic is not a pass. Empty raw stdout/stderr is permitted with intact capture identity.

failure_policy.first_concrete_failure: Preserve capture and report precise failing acceptance/assertion and candidate. Do bounded read-only diagnosis; do not edit implementation or rerun to manufacture success.
failure_policy.remaining_checks: May continue independent checks when safe to identify other concrete blockers; do not claim unexecuted checks passed.
failure_policy.repair: Generator owns correction in a fresh governed attempt; changed candidate requires renewed Mode B and appropriately fresh QA.
failure_policy.authority_or_isolation_breach: Stop immediately and notify Root; no waivers or synthetic capability proof.

known_context_limits: Generator AC01-03 success and AC04 helper failure are reported handoff context only until their retained evidence is read; no independent product result is inferred.
Product source hash prefix 6609f1f6 is not a frozen candidate identity.
Existing F3/F4 diagnostic results are excluded from F1/F2 acceptance and do not assert those followups are repaired.
Preparation itself is neither a QA verdict nor a completion/merge/publication approval.
